card.name: Table footnote letters and abbreviation keys
card.fires_on: Footnote markers (b, c, d) at the start of a table note, and the word Abbreviations or the equals sign inside an abbreviation key under a table. It also fires on the start of a references or footnotes heading.

modes.label: Footnote letters
modes.description: A single letter that begins a new table footnote right after the previous note ends.

modes.label: Abbreviation key
modes.description: The word Abbreviations, or the = or unit pieces inside a list of abbreviation definitions.

modes.label: Footnotes heading
modes.description: Partway through a heading such as REFERENCES AND FOOTNOTES.
